teaser.en: Its leaves bunch at the tips of stubby side-shoots, and its small berries are a sweet find in dry bush.
teaser.sw: Majani yake hujikusanya kwenye ncha za machipukizi mafupi ya pembeni, na matunda yake madogo ni tunu tamu katika vichaka vikavu.
teaser.dg: Makodzage ganakala phamwenga kpwenye ntsa za mapanda madide mafupi, na matundage madide ni chitu cha mtswano cha kuphaha kpwenye vitsaka vya phatu pha mvula chache.

summary.en: *Mnago*, the lowveld milkberry, is a small tree of dry bushland and woodland with small edible berries. Its wood is used for poles.
summary.sw: *Mnago* ni mti mdogo wa vichaka vikavu na misitu ya wazi wenye matunda madogo yanayoliwa. Mti wake hutumika kwa nguzo.
summary.dg: *Mnago* (kpwa Chingereza *lowveld milkberry*) ni muhi mdide wa vitsaka na weruni wa phatu pha mvula chache, wenye matunda madide ganagoriwa. Nyama za muhi nkuhumirwa kpwa nguzo.

about.en: *Mnago* is a small tree. Its leaves are crowded at the tips of short spur shoots, giving the branches a tufted look. It bears small berries. Like other members of its family, it has milky sap.
about.sw: *Mnago* ni mti mdogo. Majani yake yamesongamana kwenye ncha za machipukizi mafupi ya pembeni, na kuyapa matawi sura ya vishungi. Huzaa matunda madogo. Kama mimea mingine ya familia yake, una utomvu kama maziwa.
about.dg: *Mnago* ni muhi mdide. Makodzage ganakala phamwenga kpwenye ntsa za mapanda mafupi, na kpwa hivyo panda zinaonekana dza mabunda-mabunda. Una matunda madide. Dza mihi yanjina ya jamiiye, una maziya.

where.en: It grows in dry bushland and woodland.
where.sw: Hukua katika vichaka vikavu na misitu ya wazi.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye vitsaka na weruni wa phatu pha mvula chache.

uses.en: The berries are edible, as in other *Manilkara* species. The wood is used for poles.
uses.sw: Matunda yake huliwa, kama ilivyo kwa spishi nyingine za *Manilkara*. Mti wake hutumika kwa nguzo.
uses.dg: Matunda nkuriwa, dza ga aina zanjina za *Manilkara*. Nyama za muhi nkuhumirwa kpwa nguzo.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mnago* for *Manilkara mochisia*, and notes that it is shared with Duruma and Giriama. It is also the Swahili name. The Mgombato dictionary also has *mnago*, but identifies it as *Manilkara sulcata*, which Pakia lists as *mtsedzi*. In English it is the lowveld milkberry.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *mnago* kwa *Manilkara mochisia*, na anabainisha kuwa linatumika pia kwa Kiduruma na Kigiriama. Pia ni jina la Kiswahili. Kamusi ya Mgombato pia ina *mnago*, lakini inautambulisha kuwa ni *Manilkara sulcata*, ambao Pakia anauorodhesha kama *mtsedzi*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *lowveld milkberry*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mnago* kpwa *Manilkara mochisia*, na anagomba kukala ni dzina ra Chiduruma na ra Chigiryama piya. Piya ni dzina ra Chiswahili. Kamusi ya Mgombato nayo ina *mnago*, ela inaandika kukala ni *Manilkara sulcata*, ambao Pakia anauandika dza *mtsedzi*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *lowveld milkberry*.

reason.en: Manilkara sulcata, which Mgombato calls mnago
reason.sw: Manilkara sulcata, ambao Mgombato anauita mnago

reason.en: Fruiting relative in the same family
reason.sw: Jamaa mwenye matunda wa familia moja
reason.dg: Ndugu wa jamii iyo-iyo unaolavya matunda

mgombato: mnago (mi) type of tree (Manilkara sulcata); mnago.
